## SegmentedControl.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `options` :: The segments to choose from.
- `value` :: The chosen value. Two-way bindable.
- `onValueChange` :: Called whenever the person chooses a segment.
- `size` :: The segment height. Text follows this unless `textSize` is set.
- `textSize` :: The text scale, independent of the segment height. Follows `size` when omitted.
- `block` :: Stretches the control to the full width of its container, with equal segments.
- `label` :: Accessible name of the group.
- `disabled` :: Blocks pointer and keyboard input.
- `name` :: The field name; a hidden input submits the value with a form.
- `surface` :: The recipe behind the track: fill, border and shadow together. @default 'elevated'
- `pad` :: The inset between the track and its segments. @default 'pad-xs'
- `indicatorSurface` :: The recipe behind the sliding indicator that marks the chosen segment. @default 'overlayed'
- `shape` :: The corner shape of the track and of the indicator. @default 'modern'
- `childTextColor` :: The ink of a segment that is not chosen. @default 'text-secondary'

## options.ts

### `interface SegmentOption`

One segment in a SegmentedControl. `T` is the type of the value it stands for.

- `value` :: The value written to `value` when the segment is chosen.
- `label` :: The visible label.
- `icon` :: An icon drawn before the label.
- `disabled` :: Shown but not choosable.

### `function valueKey`

A string for a value — the form value of a hidden input, and a stable DOM key.
